HyperCut uses HyperFrames Studio, Studio Server, Player, Core and Parsers 0.8.146 from HeyGen's official packages: https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes.

The original Studio interface and bundled dependency notices are retained. The accompanying hyperframes-LICENSE contains the upstream Studio Apache License 2.0. Other dependencies retain their respective package licenses. HyperCut's canonical OpenCut host adapter is a separate addition; it does not modify the installed upstream source files.
